model: Effective corporate risk management operates as an integrated, continuous cycle beginning with structured risk identification and assessment aligned to strategic objectives and governance frameworks. Based on prioritized risks, companies deploy a mix of mitigation strategies—including avoidance, transfer, and contingency planning—while fostering a strong risk-aware culture that shapes perception and communication. Ongoing monitoring of key risk indicators feeds iterative improvement processes, enabling adaptive responses and reinforcing resilience. This dynamic loop ensures risks are proactively managed to support informed decision-making and sustainable organizational success.
